transcript: My friend, if you are tired, it does not mean you are broken. If you feel heavy, it does not mean you failed. It means you have been carrying too much for too long, without being taught how to put it down. Many people try to heal by forcing themselves forward. More discipline, more effort, more pretending they are okay. But the body does not heal through force, and the heart does not open through pressure. Healing begins the moment you stop fighting yourself, when you listen instead of judge, when you slow down enough to hear what the pain is trying to teach you. You don't need to become someone new. You don't need to fix everything at once. You only need the courage to pause, to soften, and to choose yourself in this moment. If your chest feels tight when the world goes quiet, if your mind keeps replaying what you thought you were already over, this is not random. This is healing, asking to begin. The ebook, Time to Heal, is not something you rush through. It is something you sit with, something you return to when the noise fades, and you finally allow yourself to feel again. If your body knows its time, you will feel it. The link is in my profile. Choose the moment.
